tools.name: kodiak_pipeline_run
tools.description: Run the full KODIAK® Posts for Today's Frontier pipeline — brief with KODIAK® marks, market US-SW-LASCRUCES etc. One brief into three ratios per product (1x1 1080x1080, 9x16 1080x1920, 16x9 1920x1080) with bear at 24,24. Same call the offline Render button makes via POST /pipeline/run. Returns report.json + preview.html + S3 renders.

brief.description: CampaignBrief dict with campaign_name, brand KODIAK®, target_region/market, target_audience, campaign_message with ®, products[] 2+ entries, language en-US

tools.name: kodiak_reference_search
tools.description: Search Kodiak reference library (design, reference images, training wins) by meaning using Nova multimodal 1024 — query like 'What worked for green chile families?' returns top-k past wins with market, audience, message, cue, zip.

q.description: Natural language query — place, audience, or message

tools.name: kodiak_retail_stores
tools.description: Store phone book — Business Locations CSV plus Store Sets + small independents + diners within 5 miles — query by market US-SW-LASCRUCES or retailer. NielsenIQ and Google Search Console reconcile per zip on same table kodiak-creatives-retail-network.

tools.name: kodiak_asset_hero
tools.description: Canto plus Shopify file endpoint wrapped with local input_assets fallback — Arnoldo Romo's asset sync path. GET /assets/{product}/hero — returns local, S3, and Canto locations for a KODIAK CAKES® product hero.

product.description: power-cakes, bear-bites, oatmeal-cup, savory-waffles etc. from data/recipes/kodiak-recipes.json
